player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} ({role}) ed say {num_rounds}-round a Matching Pennies. 
- Onda't round, isubmit mo so [heads] o [tails] (o [h], [t]). 
- No makatugma so pili mo ed pili na kalaban mo, Player 0 so nanalo na round; no agno, Player 1 so nanalo. 
 Sagot ka ed pili mo ed porma '[heads]' o '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sala so porma; pakatukneng so '[heads]' o '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Pinili ni Player 0 so {choice0}; pinili ni Player 1 so {choice1}. Match -> Player 0 nanalo
message.round_mismatch: Player 0 picked {choice0}; Player 1 picked {choice1}. Mismatch -> Player 1 wins.

outcome.p0_wins: Mas dakel so analo na Player 0.
outcome.p1_wins: Say unona et dakel so analo to.
outcome.draw: Diad interon dula et anggapoy agawaan.
